featured_reviews.review_text:
Kotak Mahindra Bank Credit Loan – My bad Personal Experience (Public Awareness)

I would like to share a significant issue I personally faced with a Kotak Mahindra Bank credit loan.

Borrowers should remain cautious: even if a settlement letter is issued, a parallel arbitration process may still continue, which can create a risk of double liability

Key concerns I noticed:
• If payments made during settlement are not reflected in the arbitration award, it becomes a serious defect.
• If arbitration notices are not properly served to the borrower, it raises questions about fairness.
• Such arbitration awards can be challenged under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act.

Borrowers are advised to ensure that arbitration proceedings are formally withdrawn or clarified before making settlement payments. Otherwise, complications may arise later.

In my experience, even after settlement discussions, arbitration notices were reportedly issued without my knowledge. At the same time, an attempt was made to freeze my account along with the settlement amount.

Emails seeking clarification were sent to the bank’s Nodal Officer, Principal Nodal Officer, and CEO, but no response has been received so far.

This post is shared purely for public awareness so that borrowers can remain cautious and informed.
